test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Carnatic music is confined to ______.

options.text: Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Haryana
Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Kerala

solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Kerala**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Carnatic Music__

 __
 
• **Carnatic music is one of the forms of Indian classical music.**
 
• It is confined to southern India, the states of** Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamilnadu, and Kerala** while the **classical music of the rest of the country is under the name of Hindustani.**
 
• The main emphasis in **Carnatic music is on the vocals.**
 
• The music is created in the **traditional octave form and the music is Kriti based** and focuses more on the** Sahithya or the lyric quality of the musical piece.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​Trinity of Carnatic Music__

 
 
• The Three Jewels of Carnatic music referred to trio composers – being **Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar, and Syama Sastri also known as the Trinity of Carnatic music.**
 
• All three of the Trinities lived and composed music in **Thanjavur, Tamilnadu.**
 
• Thanjavur has been the capital of **Carnatic Music, not only because the Trinities lived there but also because the place has nurtured Carnatic music for a long time.**
 
• The** Kings from Thanjavur – the Cholas, Nayaks, and the Marathas –** have consistently supported **Carnatic music and the artists, and contributed to its current-day greatness and preservation. **
 
• Muthuswami Dikshitar was the youngest of the trinities.
